coined_terms.canonical_definition: Pathos in Aristotle is not univocal; it is used in at least four registers: an ontological sense (Met. Δ 21, 1022b15 — alterability, the determination of any being that admits of being-affected); a perceptual-affective sense (DA III.7, 431a8-10 — pleasure/pain valence co-given with aisthēsis); a rhetorical-emotional sense (Rhet. II.1, 1378a20-22 — the determinate higher-order emotions: anger, fear, pity, shame); and a bodily-physiological sense (DA I.1, 403a30-b1 — boiling of the blood about the heart).
coined_terms.aristotelian_correlate: Met. Δ 21, 1022b15-21 (alterability); DA III.7, 431a8-12; Rhet. II.1, 1378a20-22; DA I.1, 403a30-b1
coined_terms.heideggerian_correlate: BCAP 131-132 — pathos as way-of-being of finite living being; sōtēria-paschein narrowing
drift_findings: Definition uniform across §§1.2–1.5 in claim-text and narrative; §1.2 already deploys the four senses + Met. Δ 21 fourfold structurally; §1.4 is the present canonical-statement site.

Covers two scopes: pathos simpliciter (object of sense present) and resonant orexis (object absent, part of resonant kinēsis).

coined_terms.canonical_definition: The residual, dual traces left behind after interacting with a sensible object and which persist. The dual traces are resonant aisthēma (formal-eidetic) + resonant orexis (affective). The chapter (§1.2) adopts the term for the residual motion understood as a whole — the ongoing activity in the sensory apparatus that persists after the sensible object has withdrawn.

coined_terms.canonical_definition: Sub-category of basic affective valence; the affective half of resonant kinēsis (alongside resonant aisthēma); the basic hedonic tonality (the 'why it matters') that remains after the object of sense departs and continues to persist. Per §1.2: the trace of pathos simpliciter persisting after the object's withdrawal — the basic valence as the dispositional residue deposited by the perceptual event in the organ.
coined_terms.aristotelian_correlate: Pathos-as-act-of-altered-being (Met. Δ 21 sense 2 applied to memory/anticipation); DA III.7

decisive_claims.text: In evaluatively complex cases, doxa does engage, and its propositional ratification of an evaluatively loaded presentation articulationally concretizes the generic resonant orexis that phantasia has co-presented into the determinate pathē that mobilizes higher-order evaluative action.
decisive_claims.force: DECISIVE: determinate pathē = concretization-of-resonant-orexis-via-doxa; resonant orexis itself is generic/basic.

decisive_claims.text: Doxa is the soul's moment of commitment: the involuntary propositional ratification, grounded in phantasia's taking-as and answerable to how things are, through which appearance becomes truth-claim and generic resonant orexis becomes the determinate mobilization of higher-order emotion.
decisive_claims.force: DECISIVE: identical to C115 — resonant orexis is generic; doxa concretizes.

decisive_claims.text: Phantasia presents, from A_1 onward, a resonant orexis constitutive of its making-present — the pleasant-or-painful orientation that Aristotle identifies as co-given with perception. This valence suffices, in simple cases, to move the animal: resonant orexis responds to the aspectually presented pleasant or painful object and appetite fires, without any propositional ratification.
decisive_claims.force: explicit: resonant orexis fires 'without any propositional ratification' in the simple case.

decisive_claims.text: Phantasia, in its taking-as-something function, is the bodily-disclosive 'making-present' through which the phantasma presents the eidos of the perceived particular with its resonant orexis. It is pre-propositional in not yet involving logos-articulation, but it is structurally eidos-disclosing.
Perceiving elicits pathos simpliciter, whereas thinking and considering — both of which operate on the phantasma of the original object of sense — are accompanied with resonant orexis.
decisive_claims.force: §1.4 corroboration: both pathos simpliciter and resonant orexis are BASIC; the concrete pathē arrive only with doxa-mediation.

decisive_claims.text: Basic resonant orexis is operative as the perception's pursue-able charge in simple appetition.
decisive_claims.force: §1.5 corroboration: explicit 'basic'-tag at the §1.5 sole-use site.

user_clarification_questions.question: Per Plan §9.1.1, is basic affective valence = pathos simpliciter ∪ resonant orexis the user's intended set-theoretic identity? Or is basic affective valence a wider category that contains both as proper subsets?

options.label: Strict identity (pipeline default)
options.description: basic affective valence = pathos simpliciter ⊎ resonant orexis. No third case. The two subterms exhaustively partition the phenomenon.

options.label: Proper-superset relation
options.description: basic affective valence ⊋ {pathos simpliciter, resonant orexis}; there are basic-valence phenomena not covered by either (e.g., basic-affective coloring of nous-activity considered apart from any phantasma).

options.label: Non-disjoint partition
options.description: pathos simpliciter and resonant orexis overlap (e.g., the kitchen-glass case of §1.3 DISS-03-C023 layers the phantasma-affect resonant orexis with drink-pathos simpliciter).

user_clarification_questions.evidence_basis: §1.4 C033 directly states the union (Option 1). §1.3 C022–C023 describe layering of resonant orexis and pathos simpliciter in the present-object case (support for Option 3). §1.4 C032 says basic affective valence is co-given with 'every thinking, every considering' which could support Option 2.
user_clarification_questions.pipeline_recommendation: Option 1 (strict identity). The §1.3 layering reads more naturally as temporally simultaneous co-presence of two distinct cases rather than as a single overlapping case; this preserves architectural cleanness.

user_clarification_questions.question: When memory or anticipation elicits articulationally concrete pathē (anger at a remembered slight, fear at an anticipated evil, shame before a recalled audience), what is the structural relation between resonant orexis and that concrete emotion?

options.label: resonant orexis = basic only; concrete pathē = resonant orexis + doxa (pipeline default)
options.description: resonant orexis IS structurally basic throughout; doxa's propositional ratification produces the concrete pathē as an articulational concretion of the underlying basic affective valence (specifically: the resonant orexis component thereof).

options.label: resonant orexis = unified affective stratum including concrete pathē
options.description: resonant orexis is a thicker, more inclusive category covering everything from bare basic valence on phantasma through higher articulated emotional structures of the Rhetoric. Concrete pathē are higher-degree determinations of resonant orexis.

options.label: Split the term
options.description: Coin a parallel term: resonant orexis (basic) + resonant pathē (concrete), with bare 'resonant orexis' reserved for basic only.

user_clarification_questions.evidence_basis: Phase 2b RETRY (DISS-03-A3) found ZERO DRIFT in §1.3: all 13 claim-level occurrences treat resonant orexis as basic / generic / pre-propositional. Decisive: DISS-03-C115 ('doxa propositionally ratifies an evaluatively loaded presentation articulationally concretizes the generic resonant orexis into the determinate pathē'), DISS-03-C129 ('through which appearance becomes truth-claim and generic resonant orexis becomes the determinate mobilization of higher-order emotion'), DISS-03-C122 ('resonant orexis... appetite fires without any propositional ratification'), DISS-03-C153 ('pre-propositional in not yet involving logos-articulation'). §1.4 C034 and §1.5 sole-use corroborate. ZERO drift counterexamples across §§1.0–1.5.
user_clarification_questions.pipeline_recommendation: Option 1 — DECISIVE recommendation based on Phase 2b evidence. No prose revision needed if user accepts; Options 2 and 3 would require multi-paragraph revision in §§1.3 and 1.4.
